title: Daniel Burka, who co-founded the agency behind the Firefox identity — 'It’s rare for me to recommend a business book, but this is a strong exception'
summary: Burka co-founded the design agency silverorange in 1999, which made the Firefox brand identity, and was director of design at Digg. He read the book against his own agency's 26 years and the governance decisions he credits for them.
blockquote: It’s rare for me to recommend a business book, but this is a strong exception. Incorruptible is a thoughtful book that should inspire founders to want more from their companies than making millions.
attribution_title: Co-founder, silverorange · former Director of Design, Digg
